title: Direct beneficiary/victim Taiwan PIT exposure feasibility audit

witnesses.financialTransmission: insurance exists and issuer preliminarily assesses no material operating/financial impact; exact loss and insurance recovery remain unknown
witnesses.effectiveTiming: fire occurred 2026-10-03 before the issuer disclosure
witnesses.falsification: Physical adverse event does not imply bearish stock direction when insurance, duration, demand, replacement cost and market expectation are unresolved.

witnesses.event: HCB303 美國新藥臨床試驗申請獲准
witnesses.economicPrimitive: regulatory permission to begin human clinical trial
witnesses.firmExposure: issuer/subsidiary directly owns the HCB303 development program
witnesses.financialTransmission: development option set advances but future clinical costs continue; no product approval, safety or efficacy validation exists; cash-flow magnitude is unknown
witnesses.falsification: IND permission is not product approval, commercial revenue or validated efficacy and therefore cannot be mapped directly to a bullish stock vote.

witnesses.event: 限制員工權利新股第一次發行
witnesses.firmExposure: issuer directly issues 516,000 restricted shares under the approved plan
witnesses.financialTransmission: retention/incentive benefit and dilution/compensation cost coexist; net financial effect is not identified by event label alone
witnesses.falsification: A direct issuer event can have economically offsetting channels and therefore requires a conflicted/unknown state.

pitContract: Freeze the event item/version and capture clock before outcome use.
Store source clock separately from connector capturedAt.
Direct exposure requires issuer/subsidiary/asset linkage in source evidence; thematic proximity is insufficient.
Issuer self-assessed materiality is a claim field, not independently verified financial truth.
Financial transmission may be POSITIVE, NEGATIVE, MIXED, CONFLICTED or UNKNOWN; direct exposure does not force a stock sign.

maturityDecision.basis: Taiwan structured material disclosures physically expose entity, event, timing, detailed mechanism and issuer-specific impact fields sufficient to build the frozen direct-exposure chain with explicit UNKNOWN/conflicted states. Multiple divergent cases demonstrate the construction is not a one-direction narrative.

exactNext: Prospectively capture new direct events before outcomes under the same state vector.
Add independent evidence where issuer impact claims can be cross-validated.
Before L4, test whether the direct-exposure state adds value beyond event category, D07 fundamentals and D11 event identity on common support.
